summary.zh: 读取小米云笔记、待办、相册与短信
summary.en: Notes, tasks, photos, and SMS from Mi Cloud

description.zh:
连接小米账号后读取小米云服务中的笔记、待办、短信、联系人、相册与录音。
首次使用需在插件页面完成小米账号登录。
description.en:
Connect a Xiaomi account to read notes, tasks, SMS, contacts, photos, and recordings from Mi Cloud.
Sign in to your Xiaomi account on the plugin page first.
